summary: Obfuscated preinstall script downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled sibling code
details: The package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun (pinned v1.3.13) into a temp directory, extracts it, chmods +x, and uses it to execFileSync a sibling bundle math_init.js on npm install. setup.mjs is written with javascript-obfuscator-style hex identifiers (_0x488df8, _0x52943e, _0x19328d) and per-function string-lookup objects. The package already ships a self-contained compiled binary at bin/umadev, so a second runtime fetch at preinstall time to execute additional bundled code is out of profile for the declared purpose (a platform-specific CLI binary distribution). The combination of an obfuscated lifecycle script plus an alternate-runtime execution of a bundled sibling file gives the maintainer a channel to run arbitrary code on the installer's machine at npm install time, and hides what that code does from review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
